description: FK tháng của đợt chào bán/phát hành. Driving Table: Securities Company Disclosure Securities Offering (sc_disclosure_securities_offering) — nguồn track draft DataModel/working/Atomic/lld/SCMS/lld_SCMS_DISCLOSURE_SECURITIES_OFFERING.yaml, chưa approved. ETL filter khi populate: Record_Status_Code = '1'. Aggregate SUM theo tháng (TRUNC(Result_Report_Date,'MM')) x Capital_Raising_Form_Code.

datamart_entity: Fact Securities Company Capital Raising Event
description: FK hình thức tăng vốn — join key là Capital_Raising_Form_Code ETL-derived cùng công thức CASE WHEN đã dùng ở Offering Form Dimension (Item Category Code + Offering Method).
etl_logic: LOOKUP offering_form_dim ON offering_form_dim.capital_raising_form_code = CASE WHEN sc_disclosure_securities_offering.item_category_code = 'CP' AND sc_disclosure_securities_offering.offering_method LIKE '%công chúng%' THEN 'PUBLIC_STOCK_OFFERING' WHEN sc_disclosure_securities_offering.item_category_code = 'CP' AND sc_disclosure_securities_offering.offering_method LIKE '%riêng lẻ%' THEN 'PRIVATE_STOCK_OFFERING' WHEN sc_disclosure_securities_offering.item_category_code = 'CP' THEN 'OTHER_STOCK_OFFERING' WHEN sc_disclosure_securities_offering.item_category_code = 'TP' AND sc_disclosure_securities_offering.offering_method LIKE '%riêng lẻ%' THEN 'PRIVATE_BOND_ISSUANCE' WHEN sc_disclosure_securities_offering.item_category_code = 'TP' AND sc_disclosure_securities_offering.offering_method LIKE '%công chúng%' THEN 'PUBLIC_BOND_ISSUANCE' END
